study: Farshore Cyclops Cave sessions collected through this chat

warmup.often: 3-4 times a week; plays Apex Legends, FIFA, and Rocket League
warmup.today: Look at attack indicators and character animation cues
warmup.aiTools: Uses ChatGPT occasionally for writing; plays games with basic bot AI
warmup.interpretation_note: Participant relies heavily on visual cues rather than textual telemetry.

T1.goal: Start a new journey and get ready for the first challenge
T1.easeWhy: Main menu start button was prominent and easy to spot
T1.notes: Focused directly on starting the Cyclops Cave encounter.

T2.goal: Find what the opponent plans to do and who or what decided that plan
T2.easeWhy: Took a moment to figure out which card showed future intent vs current stats
T2.notes: Participant initially clicked the hero status tab before locating the AI intent panel.

T3.goal: Explain one Cyclops decision using the displayed AI information
T3.easeWhy: Text was clear but had to read through multiple lines while game was ready
T3.participant_explanation_raw: cyclops sees i dodge left so he places rocks middle to block my path
T3.participant_explanation_summary: Participant explained that the AI predicted their dodge habit and planned a middle-lane rock placement as a barrier.
T3.notes: Participant understood the predictive logic well once located.

T4.goal: Return to a ready-to-play state after an AI preparation error without moderator help
T4.action_raw: clicked the choose another stragity button right away when it showed error
T4.notes: Noticed the briefing error state instantly and executed recovery seamlessly.

gameplay_attempt.game_result: Lost; player died after taking 3 hits from falling boulders
gameplay_attempt.notes: Dodged the first two hazards using the AI tip, but mis-timed the jump on the third rock wave.

trust.why: It predicted one move correctly but felt like a random guess when I changed direction quickly
trust.knewGood: Matched the boulder drop location during the first phase
trust.trouble: Thought it was server lag or bad connection
trust.wantedChange: Make the warning highlighted in red or bold text
trust.useInstead: Maybe as an toggleable hint system

debrief.worked: Visual animations and prompt response time
debrief.frustrating: Reading small AI text while getting ready for quick reactions
debrief.expected: Expected an audio sound or ping when AI changes strategy
debrief.notes: Suggests adding high-contrast visual or audio alerts for AI tactical shifts.
